description: Contacts: log that the user was in touch with a contact ('I replied to Vadim', 'called Mum'): kind message, call, meeting, note, check_in or thought_of. Private to the owner. person_id (an owned contact) or person_name (linked only on one resolve_person match; otherwise nothing is logged and the candidates come back). With reply_id it also marks that Pending Reply sent: this interaction is the reply's one write-back (a later resolve adds no second). summary: one line in your own words, never email text or a subject. occurred_at: when it happened (ISO), default now; not in the future. Never sends anything. Requires API key or OAuth with context.write. ($0.05; API key required)

occurred_at.description: When it happened (ISO date-time). Default now.

person_name.description: The contact as the user said it ("Vadim"); linked only on one match.

reply_id.description: A Pending Reply (get_pending_replies) this closes as sent.

request_id.description: Client idempotency key (retries return original result).

summary.description: One line (max 280) in your own words. Never the email body, subject or sender.

name: log_interaction

created.description: False when it was already stored (a retry, or the reply's write-back).

interaction.description: The interaction in the contact's history (private to the owner).

kind.description: message, call, meeting, note, check_in or thought_of

source.description: mcp, or pending_reply when it closes a reply

reply.description: One reply the user owes (Inbox → Pending Replies). Dayze never sends it.

approved_at.description: PHI-427: when the owner approved the draft and opened it in Gmail, or null. Dayze never sends; the Gmail sync closes the reply when the email goes out.

draft.description: The reply text saved for later.

due.description: Owed now: pending, or snoozed with snooze_until passed. False while a snooze runs, and when sent or dismissed.

person_id.description: Linked contact id; null when the reply is unlinked.

source.description: The email it answers, as ids only; null when none was saved.

state.description: unsent (pending or snoozed), sent (the owner replied) or dismissed

reply_resolved.description: True when this call marked the reply sent.

title: Log Interaction
